name: Skill detail is master-detail and its Context tab shows the project context picker
description: From /skills, click the seeded breaking-change-detector card: it navigates straight to /skills/<id> (no preview drawer) and the left 'Skills' list is present. Loading the same skill with ?tab=context opens the Context tab: the 'Project context to use' title and the Repository picker are visible. Read-only (no attach/detach clicks, no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
